nodes.label: Task-relevant lessons guide (recall.md)
nodes.rationale: Used once the task is known and again when its topic changes, because SessionStart can only supply navigation while the task is still unknown; inspected candidates are reused inside an unchanged task rather than re-queried per message.

nodes.label: Retrieve, then judge procedure
nodes.rationale: The tool only returns candidates, so the agent must open each source and read the full lesson and its conditions before applying it; an old highly relevant lesson beats a fresh unrelated one, and an empty result is never filled with recent unrelated entries.

nodes.label: Recall result statuses (CANDIDATES, NO_MATCH, PARTIAL)
nodes.rationale: Exit 0 on CANDIDATES or NO_MATCH means the bounded scan completed, not that a lesson is correct or applicable; read and budget problems surface as PARTIAL with exit 1 instead of a successful empty result.

nodes.label: Scan budgets and search boundaries
nodes.rationale: Hard limits of 1 MiB per file, 32 MiB total and 10,000 directory entries bound the scan; exceeded limits or changing files make the result partial, and ranking uses distinct rare task terms and title matches with dates only breaking ties.
